setupNotes: The documented PUT API-update method returned 405; the installed CLI implementation uses PATCH, which succeeded. No runtime or schema code was changed.
Twenty minimal-pin cached attempts returned -32603 before the selected parser warning identified missing properties. All are retained and excluded from drift comparisons.
An initial wrong gateway inventory path returned 403 and was corrected using the API specification.
One unauthenticated artifact-download attempt was rejected before a host-scoped authenticated download succeeded; its HTTP status was not retained and is not invented.

Portal Exchange YAML initially decoded with the wrong response encoding; the raw UTF-8 fetch parsed successfully. A local driver filename initially shadowed the standard bisect module; it was renamed before the feature sweep.
